evidenceClass: local scratch software comparison; no machine observations

method.intake: Strict parse, project exact KCode trace, run isolated copies of baseline machine-safety.ts with only carry classification changed. Retain all geometry, transfer handling, 7-needle threshold, 36-covering-knit threshold and existing empty-move behavior.

policies.before: Track attached spans after an explicit non-loop-forming carrier move only.
policies.all_within_pass_carries: Also track the final stitch-to-stop span after every knit/tuck pass.
policies.next_use_move_or_end: Also track the final stitch-to-stop span when the next carrier use is non-loop-forming or absent. A future loop after that move does not cancel this classification.
policies.final_loop_only: Also track the final stitch-to-stop span after the carrier's last loop-forming pass in the complete trace; a later knit, tuck or split excludes the earlier within-pass span. Existing explicit empty-move checks remain unchanged.

method.findingCount: One attached-yarn finding per crossing pass and exposed carrier under the existing checker; counts are not physical failures.
method.candidateCompilation: Fresh candidates use compileColorworkProject then authoredKnitoutToKCodeWithTrace. The stored package is inspected separately. No source candidate files were edited.
method.lowLevelCompilation: compileChartToKnitout followed by writeKnitoutProgram and authoredKnitoutToKCodeWithTrace; developerMode=true, needleOffset=50, wastePasses=4, bindOff=drop, backBedStyle=birdseye.

patterns.test146: Two rows: row 0 all default cream; row 1 has each extra colour at x=i for colour index i=1..N-1. Generalizes from-chart-jacquard-birdseye.test.ts:146.
patterns.edges: Four rows: extra colours at x=i-1 on even rows and x=width-i on odd rows; all remaining cells cream.
patterns.stripes: Four rows: row y is entirely colour y modulo N.

lowLevelMatrix.patternCarriers: 2 through N+1, ordered cream/navy/rust/green; default key palette plus 1x1 extra keys.

method.authoredSparseMatrix: Four-colour charts, widths20/40/100, four rows stored top-to-bottom as solid colours3/2/1/0; createColorworkProjectV1 with needleOffset40 and its default minimal Birdseye strategy.
method.referenceUseSequenceCount: For each carrier, select passes carrying that carrier with non-null carrier stops. Count a loop-forming use immediately followed by an empty use when any later use forms a loop. Knit/tuck/split count as loop formation; pass examples below are one-based.
method.totalErrors: Across these emitted candidates, all safety errors were attached-yarn findings; table counts therefore also equal total safety-error counts. The synthetic controls isolate one rule and do not make that assertion.

summary.conclusion: Final-loop-only preserves every audited reference and current authored candidate. Its new positive witness is synthetic; no new final-loop-positive emitted candidate was found. Broad classification adds90 findings to already-blocked low-level cases, all excluded by both narrower variants.

arcBirdInput.settings: 134 needles,45-row folded2x2 rib cuff,86 chart rows,56cm head,-10% ease,C3/C4; body gauge26/34 and rib gauge30/32 assumed. Recompile once with Fairisle and once with Birdseye strategy. Local project contains the Arc bird placement; no image or candidate bytes copied into this audit.

syntheticControls.case: No later carrier loop; next use moves home

syntheticGeometry: Carrier3 knits front90/95/100 and stops112.5; carrier4 then knits front101..110. Synthetic traces isolate attached-yarn classification and are not independently exportable machine candidates.
limitations: This records prototype policy comparison, not a production verification receipt, browser validation, controller acceptance or physical safety proof.
The inspected files are a bounded corpus; zero findings does not prove absence of false positives or missed hazards in other programs.
A next empty carrier move does not prove retirement:490 reference sequences resume loop formation later.
The final-loop policy deliberately leaves continuing within-pass carries outside the added check. It does not establish that those carries are physically safe.
KCode cannot prove cutting/in-out lifecycle. Drop/recast attachment, within-pass timing, and physical qualification of inferred clearance remain separate work.
The20/40-needle low-level witnesses already have baseline attached-yarn errors; broad-only additions do not demonstrate a currently exportable candidate newly becoming unsafe.
Arc bird input is a local ignored project; reproducing those exact hashes requires that input. This audit retains its hash without redistributing the project or image.
Thresholds and reported geometry are retained software assumptions; no acceleration, tension, yarn-shape or physical-clearance measurements were made.
